baseline.description: Unmodified captured launch command and effective settings

admission-6.description: Only change the active-request cap; six full contexts are NOT guaranteed

mtp-off.description: Remove all speculative settings; automatic admission and cache allocation may change

memory-088-mtp-off.description: Matched MTP-off comparison to memory-088: keep static memory fraction at 0.88 and pin the current effective FlashInfer attention backend while removing speculation; automatic allocation/admission changes must be captured

mtp-shallow.description: One experimental factor: reduce draft depth to one step / two draft tokens

prefill-4096.description: Only change prefill chunk size to 4096

prefill-16384.description: Only change prefill chunk size to 16384

memory-088.description: Only change static memory fraction to 0.88; capture automatic capacity/admission changes and GPU memory telemetry; high-risk, requires measured headroom and separate approval

memory-088-mamba-070.description: Relative to memory-088, lower only the Mamba/full-KV memory ratio from 0.9 to 0.7; retain MTP. Operator-approved deployment/startup/interface smoke recorded on 2026-10-16; long-context performance remains unqualified; see docs/SESSION_HANDOFF.md for serving state

metrics-on.description: Observability-only candidate; remeasure rather than mixing with original baseline
